title: Master of Arachnalisks (1399)
problem: The side test is the wrong way round. The bonus is added to Poison on a creature on the holder's own side (and counts Arachnalisks on that side). Enemies' Poison is never increased. With your own Master and a Poisoned creature of yours, that creature takes more Poison damage. For comparison, Arachnophobia (521) in the same function uses the correct "opposite side" test.
notes: Community claim: Doesn't work. Evidence: bc_CalculatePoisonDamage: victim.slot > 0 && scr_AnyAllyHasPassive(1399) @0x1406797af / 0x14067983d; victim.slot == 0 && scr_AnyEnemyHasPassive(1399) @0x140679895 / 0x14067991d; count bc_CountRace(bc_GetAlliesOf(victim, true, true), "Arachnalisk") @0x1406799e2 / 0x140679a8f; × 0.2 @0x140679b24. Fix sketch: Swap the two side checks, and count with bc_GetEnemiesOf(victim) (3 call-target edits, S; H if the argument count must change). Triage 2026-10-26: S: swap the two side checks (AnyAlly <-> AnyEnemy) and count Arachnalisks with bc_GetEnemiesOf(victim) instead of bc_GetAlliesOf (3 call-target edits; verify argument counts match before building). 2026-10-26: built as byte patch SU-0166 (verified against the baseline exe; not yet run in game).

release_notes.intended: Enemies take 20% more Poison damage for each Arachnalisk on your side.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the bonus went to Poison on the holder's own side.
